about: Tests deferred by R51 S0 (merge with the refuse-all pin). Each carries #[ignore = "R51 <slice>: <reason>"]; `slice` is the slice that ports what the test exercises. Every sealed run is refused until S6 flips SEAL_RUNTIME_COMPLETE, so a test whose control is an honest sealed run re-enables at S6 at the earliest; S6 empties this list. crates/axon-core/tests/r51_deferred_tests.rs fails if this list and the ignored set differ.
